# T-3: Stop review mutation

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Change draft review execution so it records findings in JSON artifacts and never writes draft.json or repair audit artifacts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- review-draft-questions writes draft-review-questions.json.
- review-draft-coverage writes draft-review-coverage.json.
- No draft review code path calls draft repair or writes draft.json.

## Implementation Notes
Remove or relocate repairDraftReviewFindings behavior into the new repair step implementation. Do not add a new retry loop; keep the existing review maxAttempts/retryCount limits resolved from FLOW_DEFINITION and agent.retryCount. Preserve JSON response parsing.

## Test Strategy
A test snapshots draft.json before review and asserts identical content after review while the JSON review artifact exists.
